payload.ask:
## Context

Real --apply was attempted directly against the main checkout (per live user decision, since running it from the item's own worktree would have written registry events for files that only exist on the unmerged branch). It crashed at target 181/332 with ENAMETOOLONG: one topic's purposeSlug is 307 characters (the classifier used the full explanatory doc title verbatim as the slug for most "why-..." explanation docs). Checking the full registry found this is systemic, not a one-off: 247 of 332 topics (74%) have a purposeSlug over 60 chars, up to 420 chars.

Separately, reviewing the resulting flat docs/<purposeSlug>/<role>.md layout (D-tsk28x-5), the user found ~180 new single-purpose directories dumped directly under docs/ too messy and wants a docs/knowledge/<purposeSlug>/<role>.md prefix instead -- a change to D-tsk28x-5's locked layout clause.

The 180 partially-applied moves (files + registry doc.path-move/demote events) were fully reverted and verified clean (dry-run back to moveCount 332, conservationErrors [], all preLifecycle active again) before this ask. A new item, tsk-ozk, now carries: (1) fixing the 247 oversized purposeSlugs with a real length-bound rule, and (2) deciding + recording the docs/knowledge/ prefix question (supersedes D-tsk28x-5). tsk-5mh now depends on tsk-ozk.

## Why this matters

This item's own scope was "run the already-designed migration," not "redesign the classifier's slug output or the locked target layout" -- both are real, but belong in tsk-ozk's own discovery/planning, not folded ad-hoc into this item's executing stage. tsk-5mh should resume its real apply once tsk-ozk resolves the slug-length and layout questions, so this park records why it stopped clean rather than leaving a claimed item silently stuck.
